implementation: TensorVS Triton kernels on AMD ROCm
memory_metric: sampled AMD-SMI current-process VRAM peak; includes resident index, query batches and GPU runtime; sampled in a separate search sweep, not an instantaneous hardware peak
timing: median of synchronized full-query sweeps with resident padded query batches; excludes recall and separate GPU memory sweep
recall: mean overlap with ground-truth top-K divided by K
